sourcePreservationAndRussianAdaptationNo.いい: Preserve irregularよ- negative/past/adverbial forms; permission takes verbて-form+もいい, not dictionary form.いいです may accept or decline; preserve the contextual warning.
sourcePreservationAndRussianAdaptationNo.おいしい: Whole美味しい spelling is not ordinary separate美=お/味=い readings; initialお is part of the modern word, not freely removable. Taste does not certify price/nutrition/safety.
sourcePreservationAndRussianAdaptationNo.丈夫: な-adjective; robust constitution or sturdy durable object, not simply cheerful mood.ジョウ+ブ is an established whole-word reading, not component-by-component modern etymology.
sourcePreservationAndRussianAdaptationNo.不味い: Preserve sourcejukujikun classification and assigned wholeまずい reading, including the sourcegikun citation, not invented regularon composition. Usually kana; problematic situations do not make all unpleasant thingsまずい.
sourcePreservationAndRussianAdaptationNo.冷たい: Preserve physical-touch and established emotionallycold uses. Recipientに is not a refrigerated object;たい here is not the desire construction.
sourcePreservationAndRussianAdaptationNo.大丈夫: Wholeな-adjective with condition/time/safety/context-dependentokay; no literalcomponent etymology. A response to an offer can meanno thanks, not unambiguousyes.
sourcePreservationAndRussianAdaptationNo.寒い: Cold surroundings and the speaker's feeling, including a room, not outdoorweather only. Translate the cold distinction directly in Russian, without universal temperature bans.
sourcePreservationAndRussianAdaptationNo.弱い: Strength/intensity/resistance/ability; weakwind is not lightweight.暑さに弱い is heat intolerance/sensitivity, not a medicaldiagnosis; preserve sourceじゃく script.
sourcePreservationAndRussianAdaptationNo.強い: Strength/intensity/team/feelings/resistance, not only muscles or large size. Preserveつよい andXに強い/寒さに強い; do not transfer other dictionaryreadings.
sourcePreservationAndRussianAdaptationNo.悪い: Quality/condition/conduct/fault, not automaticallyevil.私が悪かったです conveys fault.悪いね is not universalpoliteapology; separateにくい readings stay distinct.
sourcePreservationAndRussianAdaptationNo.晴れ: Noun/fineweather withの before anothernoun; no necessaryheat. Actually read天気 fairweather sense requires an additionaldirect safeguard, not a wholeweather clique.
sourcePreservationAndRussianAdaptationNo.晴れる: Intransitiveichidan;晴れています is a resultingclearcondition. A forecast does not claim rain juststopped; figurativeuses are not all identical.
sourcePreservationAndRussianAdaptationNo.暑い: Ambient hotweather/room atmosphere; hotter surroundings do not itself state enjoyment. Preservecontrast with熱いobjects and暖かいwarmth; APIotherglosses alone do not prove every spelling is interchangeable.
sourcePreservationAndRussianAdaptationNo.暖かい: Pleasantwarmth; writtenかい is not the wholegrammaticalstem. Preserveusual暖かいair/温かいfood-kindness distinction as a tendency, sharedreading, and colloquialあったかい.
sourcePreservationAndRussianAdaptationNo.曇り: Nouncloudiness, optional曇 spelling; not anい-adjective or the cloud雲. Preserve mirrorfogging and its distinction from atmospheric霧.
sourcePreservationAndRussianAdaptationNo.曇る: Intransitivegodan, affectedthingが; preserveくもります notくもます. Weatherclouding and surfacefogging do not necessarily mean rainfall.
sourcePreservationAndRussianAdaptationNo.涼しい: Pleasantcoolness, primarilyair/place/weather; grammaticalnegative replaces finalい only. Refreshingideas are not automatically涼しい, nor everycolddrink.
sourcePreservationAndRussianAdaptationNo.熱い: Hotobjects/liquids, directい-adjective, negative熱くない; noun熱 isねつ rather than merely deletingい to makeあつ. Feverconstruction熱がある remains.
sourcePreservationAndRussianAdaptationNo.甘い: Sweetness versusdeliciousness; foods can combine sweet/bitter/sour, not one universalopposite. Preserve甘すぎます; additionalguardproposals stay pending.
sourcePreservationAndRussianAdaptationNo.疲れる: Intransitiveichidan; personsubject, not transitivecausation. Preserve resulting疲れている and currentfeeling疲れた;れる is not by itself passive. Fatigue is not sleepiness/pain/diagnosis.
sourcePreservationAndRussianAdaptationNo.痛い: い-adjective even when Russian usesболит; bodypart+が, polite痛いです not痛いだ. Preservenegative/past, noun頭痛ツウ comparison, and no diagnosticcause claim.
sourcePreservationAndRussianAdaptationNo.苦しい: N3source-negativeprovider; body/emotion/finances/pressure, not just a hardpuzzle. Preservephysical/mentaloverlap without absoluteboundaries, source苦い and楽 comparisons.
sourcePreservationAndRussianAdaptationNo.辛い: Frozen mainreadingからい/N5 and spicytaste; separately taughtつらい has its own actual lexicalentry/inflections. Do not assignつらい to the curryexample or change JLPT from APIalternatereading. Salt/strictcriticism extensions and hottemperature distinction remain.
sourcePreservationAndRussianAdaptationNo.雪: Nounsnow/snowfall, not a verb; distinguish ongoingfalling from snowalreadyonroad. Preserveセツ in積雪 and particle roles, without depth/safetyinferences.
sourcePreservationAndRussianAdaptationNo.風: Nounwind/breeze; distinguish ordinarywindかぜ from風邪illness and styleふう. Captured irregularillnessspelling is not proof everyかぜ sense has the same normalspelling.
